independent_self_review.bounded_confirmation: playing_runtime.py:335-353 preserves strict newer received current-position matching plus arrival_confirmed. No-feedback requests retry the same pending point, at most three retries one second apart. After the final one-second wait, NativeTelemetryUnavailable is raised with pending retained. Late actual matching receipts reconcile; actual0091 metadata legitimately resets pending. No send, destination-only reply, stale sequence or unrelated position advances optimistically.
independent_self_review.life_safety: A received SELF death remains dead after0091. Warp does not promote alive, class freshness or authentication authority. Existing pose/session readiness gates remain in force.
